responseMessageContents.text:
The user is asking about the "Try Rork Max" button in the bottom right. This is a UI element of the Rork platform itself, not something in their app code. They mentioned they already paid for Rork Max and are wondering how to use it.

This is a platform/billing question, not a coding question. I should let them know this is outside my scope and direct them to support.

That's a platform UI element, not part of your app. If you've already paid for Rork Max but it's not reflecting, please contact Rork support to resolve the billing/account issue — I can only help with building your app.
